text: {"lessons":["I should set clear risk limits and review a position before a loss becomes severe, rather than letting loss aversion or my average cost delay a decision.","Repeatedly adding to a stock should require a fresh investment case; a recent purchase or price movement alone is not a reason to buy more.","I should decide in advance how I will manage a winning position, so the satisfaction of realizing gains does not lead me to sell automatically or without considering the remaining upside."]}
